name: Zouve
description: Plays music in voice: YouTube, YouTube Music, Spotify, Apple Music and Deezer links, or a song or artist by name.

commands.name: play
commands.description: Plays a song, or adds it to the queue; alone, resumes

commands.name: queue
commands.description: Shows what plays now and next

commands.name: stop
commands.description: Empties the queue and leaves the channel

settings.label: Language
settings.description: What Zouve writes in the chat in.

settings.label: Volume
settings.description: 0 to 100. Everyone can still turn Zouve down for themselves.

settings.label: Longest queue
settings.description: Songs that may wait in one channel.

settings.label: Say what is playing
settings.description: Writes “Now playing” in the chat at each song.

settings.label: Clean up the chat
settings.description: When Zouve leaves voice, deletes the commands typed to it and what it answered.

settings.label: Spotify client ID
settings.description: From an app at developer.spotify.com. Without it, only single Spotify tracks are read, by their title.
